_note: Deadlines for the 2026 tax year (returns filed in 2027), from standard CRA rules. When a date falls on a weekend or holiday the CRA usually accepts the next business day. The client should confirm these each year.

hero.title: Never miss a tax deadline.
hero.text: Key CRA dates for the 2026 tax year, for individuals, the self-employed and businesses.

items.title: Fourth-quarter instalment
items.text: Final 2026 instalment payment, if the CRA asked you to pay by instalments.

items.title: Year-end for donations and expenses
items.text: Last day for charitable donations and most deductible expenses to count for 2026.

items.title: T4 and T5 slips
items.text: Employers and payers send T4 and T5 slips by the end of February.

items.title: RRSP contribution deadline
items.text: Last day to contribute to an RRSP and deduct it on your 2026 return.

items.title: Trust returns
items.text: T3 returns for trusts with a December 31 year-end are due within 90 days of year-end.

items.title: Personal tax filing and payment deadline
items.text: File your 2026 return and pay any balance owing to avoid interest and penalties.

items.title: Self-employed filing deadline
items.text: Self-employed individuals and their spouses or partners file by June 15. Any balance is still due April 30.

corporate.title: Corporations
items: T2 corporate returns are due six months after the end of the tax year.
Any balance owing is generally due two months after year-end, or three months for some Canadian-controlled private corporations.

source.text: Dates follow standard CRA rules. Check your own situation, or ask us.
source.label: CRA due dates
